name: overdue-notice
title: Draft overdue notice
for_each: SELECT DISTINCT b.id,b.code FROM borrowers b JOIN loans l ON l.borrower_id=b.id WHERE l.returned_on IS NULL AND l.due_on<CURRENT_DATE

sections.title: Borrower
sections.sql: SELECT code,name FROM borrowers WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Please check these outstanding loans
sections.sql: SELECT c.barcode,t.name title,l.due_on FROM loans l JOIN copies c ON c.id=l.copy_id JOIN titles t ON t.id=c.title_id WHERE l.borrower_id=$1 AND l.returned_on IS NULL AND l.due_on<CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY l.due_on
sections.note: Draft only. A librarian checks the dates and contact details before delivery. No fine or payment is requested.

name: hold-slip
title: Hold collection slip
for_each: SELECT id,source_key FROM holds WHERE state='ready'

sections.title: Ready for collection
sections.note: Private staff copy. Check whether the collection deadline has passed before handing over.

sections.title: Copies
sections.sql: SELECT v.barcode,v.title,v.condition,v.loans_count,v.last_issue,v.waiting FROM collection_review v JOIN copies c ON c.id=v.id WHERE c.branch_id=$1 ORDER BY v.barcode
